Dear Ms. Thomas,

Receiving your dispute letter regarding the above-referenced account, we acknowledge your assertion that the account has already been paid. We take all disputes seriously and are committed to resolving this matter in accordance with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and the laws of the State of Illinois.

We have reviewed the account information and confirm that the current balance is $5,906.53. Our records indicate that the original creditor is Valley Regional Hospital. We also note that the account was charged off on 2021-07-08.

Regarding your request for validation, we confirm that we are a debt collector attempting to collect a debt owed by you. We are required to provide you with validation of the debt, which includes the name of the creditor, an itemization of the debt, and a statement that unless you dispute the validity of this debt within 30 days after receiving this notice, we will assume the debt to be valid. Please note that you have already requested validation, and we will provide this information to you in a separate mailing.

We will investigate your dispute and take the necessary steps to verify the accuracy of the account information. If our investigation confirms that the account has been paid, we will take the necessary actions to update our records accordingly.

You have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe that the account has not been paid in full. Please note that you may request a written acknowledgement of the dispute from us.

Sincerely,

Continental Receivables Corp.
